name: Outer/Inner Shell Classification
aliases: Six outerShell coplanaires et un innerShell géométrique
definition: A classification system for polygonal geometry in a voxel cell, separating polygons into six outerShell groups based on boundary planes and one innerShell group for internal geometry.
summary: Outer/Inner Shell Classification partitions geometry into boundary-coplanar outer shells and internal inner shells to prevent interior polygons from incorrectly occluding the shell.
